g.text: Drawing MFG-FD-MET-03 | Part FD-MET-03 — Common auger and anti-bridge agitator shaft | Qty 1
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: 304 shaft | Process/finish: turn Ø8 shaft + cross-drill + weld/pin Ø4 paddles
Overall: X 120.000 × Y 100.000 × Z 300.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: Ø8 h8=7.978–8.000 x300; Ø3.00 +0.05/0 cross-holes at Z8 and Z292; lower hole matched with FD-MET-02, upper with FD-CP-01; paddle sweep
Ø50/100/120 at Z183/228/273; straightness0.10; 2.2 N·m design torque SF≥2
GD&T/datums: A=common journal axis; B=drive-end shoulder/face; C=keyway or retaining feature plane; verify datum marking on supplier inspection
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; micrometer bearing seats; dial-indicator TIR/runout
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Artifact check: PASS only; fabrication HOLD pending full v0.8 gates. Physical NOT_RUN; machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
